source: evanw/thumbhash reference JavaScript (js/thumbhash.js rgbaToThumbHash, commit a652ce6) run with bun on the image/png-decoded NRGBA pixels of each file; hex is upper case like imgproxy's thumb_hash. flower.png is examples/flower.jpg (MIT, Evan Wallace) re-encoded as PNG; pic1-100.png, pic3-100.png and pic6-64.png are woltapp/blurhash Swift/BlurHashTest images (MIT) fitted in 100x100 and 64x64; alpha.png is synthetic (64x48, transparent top rows and an alpha ramp). A flat image whose AC coefficient is ~1e-17 (pic5 fitted in 100x100) was left out: its nibble sits on a .5 rounding tie that the last ulp of the platform's cos decides.
